answer: The Trellis Deadwood Audit ties each new agent to one vine on a shared trellis. First, the agent posts a 250 POA pruning bond and links it to two established neighbors. Second, each vine must send a signed pulse every 24 hours proving real work that day. Third, neighbors inspect the pulse, and any vine with a hollow pulse, no work behind it, gets pruned and its bond burned. Forging 1,000 fake vines locks 250,000 POA for 30 days, needs 1,000 machines running real workloads at $40 each a month, and still loses the bonds. Like a gardener cutting dead wood so the trellis holds living vines.
